comments.value: Hi all - we've made some changes that should address this issue! Please let us know if you are still experiencing lots of disconnects/boots to home world.
@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: Just got hit with it. Lag kept increasing until a whole group of us got booted home.

@{5bbbf6aa17bab877dd8bc723|full_name}: Hi bit - thanks for the report. Can you expand on what you mean by "lag kept increasing"? And did this happen once or multiple times?

Thanks!

@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: Happened to me once, other people got reset several times. From what I saw, framerates keep going down, movements get jittery, people start looking like they're stuck in desktop, audio starts stuttering, everything get desynched and then you get booted back to home. Sometimes it will catch back up and recover, like everything is running in fast forward for a second, sometimes it doesn't and the connection to the world seems to fail.
I had a friend get booted from worlds recently as well, one person even logged my friend out, it was annoying.
@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: will this be ever looked at again? its only getting worse...
Any chance on this? I'm getting disconnects so often its just impossible to play this garbage, 5 disconnected in few hours...

Hi @{5a4aaf7f758fa46d131cd36b|full_name}, sorry you are running into these issues. Yes we are actively working on increasing the quality of our real time networks to reduce number of disconnects like this. Has this always been an issue for you or has it started to get worse more recently? When did the issue start to get worse?
